exposure: Antibiotic prescriptions in the 1st year of life
cohort: 797,318 singleton children born in Sweden between 1 July 2005 and 30 September 2013.
finding: Antibiotic prescriptions in the first year of life, mainly for acute otitis media and respiratory tract infections, were associated with an increased risk of type 1 diabetes before age 10 years.
mod_finding: The association between antibiotic use in the first year of life and type 1 diabetes was stronger among children delivered by cesarean section.
